result:
**Round 119 verdict: PASS.** I ran every browser row in real Chromium at both 1440×900 and 1280×720, so `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. There are no app bugs.

| Row | Result |
|---|---|
| T119-TARGETED | 25 of 25 files, 452 of 452 tests pass (my own run). CF11 is green with `toBe(-1)`. |
| SOURCE-SCOPE | All 929 entries in B's frozen list match, checked at the start, after the tests and at the end. The `git status` output is unchanged (same 8 modified and 2 untracked paths, md5 `554bfcc8…`). The four protected auth/route files are unchanged. No `store/` writes during my phase. |
| AN-REVIEW | **Test file:** putting `-1.2` back on line 501 in a copy gives `261472d6…`, so exactly one line changed. Counts are 92 / 14. **Doc 100:** putting back the old line 69 gives `5912f18f…`, so exactly one line changed. **Doc 101:** checked by content only (see below). |
| SH-MASTER, both viewports | A plain −40 px drag gives −27.5 dB. With Shift held it gives −2.5 dB, within one 0.5 dB Master step of the expected −2.75. Each drag makes exactly one `Master Volume` undo entry, and undo returns to 0. |
| GV-DRAG, both viewports | A −20 px drag on the 48 px group fader gives −25.0 dB (expected −25.0 ± 1.35). It makes one `Volume` entry, and Ctrl+Z returns `+0.0 dB`. |
| G119-3 (run alone, last) | In a fresh context with no login, `/studio-lab` opens with the demo badge. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio loaded. The token API returns 401, so premium auth is not bypassed. The fake-Bearer 403 check is BLOCKED because the backend isn't available in the cloud. |
| PX-NET / REG-HYD | Across the 5 measured sessions: no requests to forbidden hosts, no `Authorization` headers, no hydration errors, no page errors. The only console errors are the known cloud noise. |

**Gaps and caveats:**
- **Doc 101 can't be fully checked (C-R119-01).** The file is untracked and nobody saved a pre-edit copy, so I can't prove that no other line changed. The four edited lines match B's text, and the deleted line is gone with no blank left. A's work looks correct. This is a process note for B (archive copies of untracked files before granting edits), not an app defect.
- **One 1440 run was invalid.** It crashed during setup on the first page load, probably a cold dev-server reload, though I didn't see the cause. It saved no network log, so it has no PX-NET/REG-HYD record. A second run replaced it, within the attempt budget.
- **The source check proves a match with B's snapshot, not with round 118's tested tree.** Round 118's C report recorded no per-file hashes. So "same tree C tested in round 118" depends on B's frozen snapshot plus the unchanged path list.
- **Carried rows:** the other round-118 browser rows are listed under `carried`, not `passed`, because the app source is unchanged. Full vitest, build, verify and e2e smoke are left to the gate.

**Ableton:**
- Shift giving a finer drag is confirmed by B's earlier capture of Live 12 manual §42.6. I didn't re-check the manual this round.
- The fine Master value snapping to the Master's own 0.5 dB step is still unconfirmed. That stays open as MASTER-FINE-STEP for the Ableton expert review.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-119.md
- c-round-119.json
- c-round-119/ (tools, logs, screenshots)
